fix(ci): support Vercel Deployment Protection bypass for visual-qa screenshots

The Gemini vision analysis (now working end-to-end after the model-match
fix) surfaced a real gap: this project's preview deployments sit behind
Vercel's Deployment Protection auth wall, so Playwright was screenshotting
the Vercel login page, not the app, on every run.

Wire in Vercel's documented 'Protection Bypass for Automation' pattern —
send the bypass secret as an x-vercel-protection-bypass header on every
Playwright request, if configured. Graceful no-op (same blocked behavior
as before) when the secret isn't set, matching this workflow's existing
pattern for GEMINI_API_KEY.

Needs a one-time manual step to actually activate: generate a bypass
secret in Vercel Project Settings -> Deployment Protection -> Protection
Bypass for Automation (for the arcanea-ai-app project), then add it as a
GitHub Actions secret named VERCEL_AUTOMATION_BYPASS_SECRET on this repo.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(build): add @arcanea/design-system to transpilePackages

Recovered from an in-progress appx-Vercel-build investigation that was
cut off mid-task. @arcanea/design-system has subpath exports and is
imported across 33 files in apps/web — matching the exact pattern the
existing transpilePackages comment already documents (avoids
'Module not found' when a workspace dep hasn't been prebuilt before
next build runs). Verified additive-only: arcanea-ai-app (the Vercel
project already building successfully) is unaffected by this list
growing, since transpilePackages only adds transpilation, never removes
existing resolution.

Note: this alone likely does not fully resolve the arcanea-ai-appx Vercel
project's build failure — its error log showed many more 'Module not
found' entries unrelated to this package (components/premium/*,
components/system/*, app/kura/*, API routes, i18n/routing.ts). Keeping
this verified partial fix; the appx root cause investigation is still open.

fix(ci): match only standard gemini-<version>-flash models, not preview/omni variants

The dynamic model resolution picked 'gemini-omni-flash-preview' because a
naive alphabetical-descending sort put it ahead of numbered versions
('omni' > numerals) — that experimental variant 400'd on this plain
text+image generateContent request. Match strictly against the standard
models/gemini-<version>-flash shape (excludes -preview/-exp/-image/-audio/
-tts/-live/-lite suffixed variants) and pick the numerically highest
version, rather than trusting string sort order.

fix(deps): revert unintended dependency drift from a forced reinstall

The previous commit's pnpm install --force regenerated the lockfile for
the whole 65-project workspace and incidentally bumped
packages/starlight-runtime's resolved @ai-sdk/anthropic from ^0.0.9 (what
its package.json actually declares) to an incompatible ^3.0.0 — unrelated
to the undici fix and never intentionally committed. Re-ran install
without --force so pnpm re-derives the lockfile respecting every
workspace package's own committed specifiers. Confirmed: @ai-sdk/anthropic
back to ^0.0.9, undici still resolves 8.5.0, audit still 0 high / 0 critical.

fix(deps): resolve undici to 8.5.0, closing the 3 high-severity advisories

pnpm audit flagged undici <8.5.0 (TLS cert-validation bypass + 2 WebSocket
DoS advisories, all same root cause). An override for this exact range
already existed in package.json but the lockfile had never been
regenerated to apply it — undici still resolved to the vulnerable 8.3.0.
Replaced the range-selector override (which pnpm wasn't matching) with a
direct pin (undici: 8.5.0, the latest published version) and forced a
clean re-resolve. Confirmed: pnpm audit now reports 0 high / 0 critical
(1 moderate remains, informational-only per the CI gate's own threshold).
